Licenses for site/vendor/qrcode.js
==================================

site/vendor/qrcode.js is a vendored, pre-bundled build of the "qrcode" npm
package (soldair/node-qrcode) plus its two inlined runtime dependencies,
dijkstrajs and encode-utf8. All three are MIT-licensed; each project's own
license text (as required by the MIT "include this notice in copies" term)
follows below. See site/vendor/qrcode.js's own header for provenance/version/
upgrade instructions, and the repository-root NOTICE file for the project-wide
attribution index this entry is part of.
